briefings.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright discusses Iran war at CERAWeek in Houston — 3/23/2026
briefings.tldr: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright detailed a shift toward "energy pragmatism," prioritizing the aggressive expansion of natural gas and nuclear power to support the AI boom while managing the global oil supply shock caused by the ongoing war in Iran.
